title: SpaceNLI: Evaluating the Consistency of Predicting Inferences In Space

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigating label imbalance by perturbing original textual inference problems to create a balanced distribution of entailment, neutral, and contradiction labels, preventing models from exploiting statistical label frequencies found in standard semantic literature.

Evaluating model consistency using a newly introduced 'Pattern Accuracy' metric, which tests whether models rely on irrelevant lexical artifacts by measuring their performance across multiple samples generated from the same reasoning pattern with different inference-preserving noun phrase substitutions.
